title: Coverage grid cells in another currency: a refund (refund, other currency), a bill, a goal and a loan on a peso account (schedules, places and loans, other currency), a conversion on a check day (convert, check day) and met by a statement line (convert, imported)
story: Home currency yen. Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank (yen) holds 400,000, of which Food 40,000 and Free to spend 60,000 (typed); GCash (pesos) holds 10,000.00, of which 3,000.00 is kept for a balikbayan box; a peso loan owes 20,000.00, paid 2,000.00 on the 15th from GCash; a GCash load of 500.00 on the 20th is paid from GCash. Pay of 300,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Tue 5 Jan: 400.00 of food with GCash, on Food; Wed 6 Jan the shop refunds it, naming Food. Thu 7 Jan: GCash checked at 12:00 (10,000.00); at 18:00, 26,500 yen converted from the bank into 10,000.00 pesos. Fri 8 Jan: the bank statement shows the 26,500 out. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the bank line of the conversion

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 400,000 (opening) - 26,500 (the conversion of Thu 7 Jan; the statement line of Fri 8 Jan is that same money) = 373,500

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 10,000.00 (check of Thu 7 Jan at 12:00) + 10,000.00 (the conversion, told at 18:00, after the check) = 20,000.00

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 373,500 (bank today) - 40,000 (Food left: the peso spend and the peso refund do not count against a yen line) = 333,500

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 20,000.00 (GCash today) - 3,000.00 (Balikbayan box, kept in it) - 2,000.00 (loan, 15 Jan) - 500.00 (load, 20 Jan) - 2,000.00 (loan, 15 Feb) - 500.00 (load, 20 Feb) = 12,000.00

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening; nothing in yen spent from it, and GCash's pesos are not in the yen headline) = 60,000
